page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-384-lssd is a memory-optimized and storage-heavy server instance belonging to the c4d family. It features 384 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, paired with 3024 GB of system memory. This configuration yields approximately 7.88 GB of RAM per virtual core, supporting large-scale in-memory computations.

The instance is equipped with 12885 GB of local NVMe SSD storage distributed across 32 local SSD devices. This integrated high-capacity storage subsystem is designed for workloads requiring low-latency, high-throughput local data access. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are included with this instance, and it does not feature any GPU accelerators.

Given its massive resource density, including 384 dedicated vCPUs and over 3 TB of RAM, this server represents a high-tier hardware profile. The inclusion of substantial local NVMe storage provides a consolidated resource footprint, eliminating the need for external storage attachments for high-I/O tasks. This makes the instance highly suitable for large-scale databases, real-time analytics, in-memory data stores, and intensive enterprise workloads that demand concurrent processing of massive datasets.
